title: Passport Rush Demo

style.look: stylized 3D cartoon characters over painted watercolor backgrounds
style.character_style: stylized 3D cartoon character, soft clean shading, expressive face
style.background_style: watercolor painting, soft washes, crisp shape edges
style.lighting: late-afternoon golden hour, low warm sun, long harsh shadows, strong volume and depth
style.physics: cartoon physics - exaggerated, bouncy, squash and stretch, but readable
rules: Characters and props stay clean stylized 3D; the painted watercolor texture lives only in the background.

locks: Maya and the Driver stay in their seats inside the taxi unless the beat says otherwise.

maya.name: Maya
maya.role: main character, a girl late for her flight
maya.personality: frantic, determined, funny but still cool
maya.description: Young woman, bright ginger messy bun, big expressive eyes, oversized blue hoodie, short pleated skirt, chunky sneakers, over-ear headphones around her neck.

driver.name: Driver
driver.personality: calm, very pleased with himself, reckless behind the wheel
driver.description: Middle-aged man, round kind face, flat cap, huge bushy mustache, short-sleeve shirt.

taxi.name: Taxi
taxi.role: the driver's old yellow taxi, a character of its own
taxi.personality: jumpy, bouncy, like a horse to its rider
taxi.description: Old rounded yellow taxi, checkered stripe, roof sign, slightly dented bumper.

trucks.name: Trucks
trucks.role: two big trucks that block the road
trucks.description: Two boxy cargo trucks, one red one green.

highway.name: Highway
highway.role: long highway from the airport to the city, no buildings nearby
highway.description: Long multi-lane highway through dry golden fields, distant hills, far-away city skyline.

shots.context: Maya bursts out of the airport doors onto the curb, realizes her passport is missing and panics.

beats.action: Maya runs out of the doors in a hurry.
She pats her pockets, anticipation pause, eyes go huge.
She spins around and frantically waves for a taxi off-screen.

shots.sfx: airport ambience, sliding doors, sneaker squeaks

shots.context: Inside the taxi back seat, Maya buckles two seat belts so they form an X over her chest.
shots.camera: Front-facing medium close-up from the dashboard.

beats.action: She pulls the left belt across and clicks it.
She pulls the right belt across, forming an X, clicks it.
Holds a tense determined pose, nodding.

locks: Her headphones stay around her neck the whole shot.

shots.context: On the highway the taxi squeezes between two trucks on two wheels and lands back on four once it is clear.

beats.action: Taxi approaches the narrow gap between the trucks.
Taxi tips onto its two left wheels.
Taxi squeezes through the gap, still on two wheels.
Only once fully clear of the trucks, it lands on all four wheels with a big squash and bounce.

locks: The taxi lands only after it has fully cleared both trucks.
